english.title: Environment Agency fail enter details of owner/occupier of premises abutting watercourse on register
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the appropriate agency, without reasonable excuse, failed to

(A)_[keep a register of persons and premises for the purposes of section 164 of the Water Resources Act 1991]_
(B)_[enter the name and address of **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) in the register for the purposes of works discharges in respect of premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), which abutted a watercourse when that person had requested to be so registered and was the owner or occupier of those premises]_
(C)_[enter the name and address of **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) in the register for the purposes of works discharges in respect of premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), which abutted a watercourse when that person had requested to be so registered and was an officer of an association of owners or occupiers of premises which abutted on that watercourse and included those premises]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 191(3) of the Water Resources Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the Environment Agency,
failed to enter the name and address of a person in the register for the purposes of works discharges
in respect of premises which abutted a watercourse
when that person had requested to be so registered and was either
the owner or occupier of those premises; or
an officer of an association of owners or occupiers of premises
which abutted on that watercourse and included those premises
